question: Which Burp tab/menu behaviours are only visible with a populated project (context menus, Target site map, Repeater history)?
probes: Capture each after sending sample traffic to Burp 6570
Use the shipped documentation screenshots as cross-check
resolution: RESOLVED (wave 26, 2026-11-15): populated-state probes captured from the live reference (screenshots burp-populated/). Findings: (1) the history context menu is the big populated-only behavior - captured item-for-item and now implemented in WebProbe with the exact set/order, wired where backends exist, disabled otherwise; (2) the Target site map does NOT populate from proxy traffic while crawl tasks are paused (reference banner: 'Task execution is paused - Site map will not be populated'), so WebProbe's history-built site map is consistent with tasks-running behavior; (3) Repeater per-tab history pager + Inspector sidebar exist on the reference; (4) NEW parity gap grounded: the reference history has an 'IP' column WebProbe lacks (next wave).
